response.sql:
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction_of_all_addresses
FROM address
GROUP BY city_id
ORDER BY fraction_of_all_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Tied fractions at the 10th position may be cut off arbitrarily, as requested; no tie-breaker is needed.
